rationale: C02 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. It shares the child's unusually specific list of six tax-return categories, a bounded inclusive range of years, inspection during a designated Congress, authorization of a Senate committee or duly authorized subcommittee, an investigation-specific purpose, compliance with a contemporaneously approved Treasury decision, and the same Federal Register effectiveness sentence. C06 and C05 use nearly the same machinery, but C02 is the closest overall because it also frames access around a focused investigation and a defined congressional period.

shared_material.parent_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1945 to 1950, inclusive
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim enumeration of return types and the same year-range construction.
